# Shadowy

> Shadowy is a team workload transparency platform that makes invisible work visible: helping colleagues, onboarding, waiting for information, coordination and other tasks that never show up in normal reports. Employees log extra work in about 30 seconds, managers review it, and the company sees real workload, recurring processes and which clients cost the most. It is a transparency tool, not employee surveillance: no screen or keystroke tracking, and employees choose what to submit.

Based in Latvia. Primary language Latvian (lv), with an English version. Free 30 day pilot, no credit card.

## Key pages
- [Home (Latvian)](https://www.shadowy.lv/): product overview, how it works, who it is for, FAQ.
- [Home (English)](https://www.shadowy.lv/en): English version of the landing page.
- [Pilot program](https://www.shadowy.lv/pilotprojekts): who the pilot is for, what you get, how it runs.
- [PB Finanses case study](https://www.shadowy.lv/projekti/pb-finanses): a real accounting firm that used Shadowy to see invisible work, team load and true client cost.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.shadowy.lv/privacy)

## What Shadowy shows
- Invisible / extra work hours that normal reports miss
- Team workload and where it is distributed unevenly
- Recurring processes worth fixing
- True cost per client, so fixed-fee clients that do not cover their work become visible
- Concrete process suggestions after a pilot

## Who it is for
Service teams of roughly 5 to 50 people: accounting and finance firms, consultancies, agencies and other professional services where part of the work stays invisible.
